title: Concept: Dependency fetched from a source archive URL
description: package.json declares a dependency pointing at a forge source archive instead of a package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive is generated on demand from a branch or tag, so the bytes are not the published artifact and carry no registry integrity value.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The archive is generated on demand from a branch or tag, so the bytes are not the published artifact and carry no registry integrity value.
